lines.text: What if all the *paint* in the world disappeared... for five seconds?
Yellow cabs. Lane lines. Crosswalks. New York runs on paint.
And the lane lines are gone. Nobody knows where to drive.
A car's whole paint job is about as thick as a *sheet of paper*.
That thin film is the only thing that makes it a taxi. City rules say a medallion cab must be *yellow*.
Five seconds later, every stripe and every cab is back.
Follow for more. What should vanish next?
